maria-ps: Heads-up — TritonHealth hit an integration blocker in staging during the SI run. Their ingest path to our private deploy is failing with a 502 on the gateway. Need quick arch review + hotfix plan. Logs below.
ashok: Looking. Can you paste the exact failing request id? also what's the deploy image tag? @devon fyi.
maria-ps: request_id=triton-req-2026-03-22-7, image=redwood/private-v1.8.2, stacktrace snippet: `ERROR http: upstream returned 502, read tcp 10.2.0.12:443: connection reset by peer`
devon: Quick glance — looks like our sidecar healthcheck is flapping under longer TLS handshake from their proxy. Might be a renegotiation edge with their LB. Workaround: increase sidecar client TLS timeout to 45s and add retry=2. Can push a canary config to their staging host now.
julia: Timeline? Triton wants a go/no-go for morning demo at 11:00 PT. We have ~2.5h. @partner-eng are they ready for a config hotpatch or do we need an image build?
partner-eng: We can do config hotpatch. I'll coordinate with Triton infra to accept the change remotely; they already approved non-disruptive toggles. We'll need a documented rollback plan.
ashok: I'll prepare a minimal config diff. Patch will toggle `sidecar.tls.client_timeout` from 15 -> 45 and set `sidecar.tls.retry_policy: {max_attempts: 2, backoff_ms: 200}`. Also add a temporary KV cache bypass for prefix X to avoid repeated replays.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-22-TritonStaging. Severity: high. Pager duty notified: devon, ashok. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03-22-TritonStaging
maria-ps: Sounds good. Devon / Ashok can you both sign off once patch is staged? I'll coordinate with Triton PM and request a smoke test of the demo flow.
devon: Staged to Triton staging (host triton-stg-02). Smoke test passed for 10/10 requests for 5 minutes. No 502s. Pushed config with `kubectl apply -f triton-sidecar-hotpatch.yaml` (logs attached).
partner-eng: Triton confirms demo flow is good. They want the patch in prod tomorrow after go/no-go call. We'll schedule a proper image fix for the next minor release (private-v1.8.3) to harden handshake code.
julia: I'll book a 30m post-mortem tomorrow to capture lessons (network edge cases + our canary docs). @maria-ps please add blocker's root cause notes to the SI runbook.
maria-ps: Added a short note to the runbook and linked the incident. Thanks all — going to update Triton PM and close loop. :thumbsup:
